			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { has_opinion = { who = FROM value = 1 } } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { treasury = 50 } }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = DA_GN_event.11.b
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_offer.cocolocogram
			clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_offer.recuverinator

			clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_offer.crammers
			clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_offer.spyglass
			clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_offer.monocles
			clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_offer.looms
			clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_offer.cranes
			clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_offer.tugs
			clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_offer.walking

			FROM = { set_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_no country_event = { id = DA_GN_event.12 } }

			factor = 1
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_opinion = { who = FROM value = 1 } treasury = 50 }
		}
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = DA_GN_event.12
	title = DA_GN_event.12.t
	desc = { trigger = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_yes } desc = DA_GN_event.12.d }
	desc = { trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_yes } } desc = DA_GN_event.12.e }
	picture = INVENTION_eventPicture
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_pending
			DA_GN_licences_upkeep = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = DA_GN_event.12.a
		hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_yes clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_no }
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = DA_GN_event.13
	title = DA_GN_event.13.t
	desc = DA_GN_event.13.d
	picture = INVENTION_eventPicture
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = DA_GN_eplus_done
			random_neighbor_country = {
				limit = { DA_GN_eplus_goblin = yes }
				save_event_target_as = DA_GN_eplus_goblin
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = DA_GN_event.13.a
		add_prestige = 10
		event_target:DA_GN_eplus_goblin = { add_opinion = { who = ROOT modifier = DA_GN_patent_suit } }
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
	}
	option = {
		name = DA_GN_event.13.b
		trigger = { treasury = 200 }
		add_treasury = -200
		event_target:DA_GN_eplus_goblin = { add_treasury = 200 }
		change_innovativeness = 3
		capital_scope = { DA_Tech_prov.Metallurgy = { amount = 150 } }
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
	}
	option = {
		name = DA_GN_event.13.c
		define_advisor = {
			type = commandant
			skill = 2
			culture = event_target:DA_GN_eplus_goblin
			religion = ROOT
			cost_multiplier = 0.5
		}
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
	}
}
